lines.text: Stop doing a 10-step skincare routine. Stacking that many actives is how barriers get wrecked.
Korean glass skin doesn't come from hoarding products. It comes from these 5 simple habits.
One: Cleanse. Melt the SPF off. Two: Hydrate. Press toner into damp skin.
Three: Treat. Pick just one active serum. Four: Seal. Lock it all in with a barrier cream.
And Five: Protect. Two fingers of SPF 50, every single morning.
That's it. 5 habits. Hit subscribe because tomorrow we're fixing your damaged skin barrier.
